description: Interview practice dataset. Product guidance is paraphrased from public OneTrust documentation. Public community reports are anecdotal and used as scenario inspiration. All case records, organizations, events, severity rules, drafts and decisions are fictional.

source_retrieval.access_note: Direct fetches of the two MyOneTrust articles returned cache misses. Their guidance comes from the publicly indexed article bodies. Community sources are public Reddit discussions. No MyOneTrust community posts were verified.

knowledge_base.title: Assessment Templates Cannot Be Recovered After Being Discarded

facts.paraphrase: Once a draft assessment template is discarded, OneTrust provides no supported way to restore the draft or its configuration.
To continue after an accidental discard, create a new assessment template and configure it again.

knowledge_base.title: Cannot find a particular Assessment Template when launching assessments

facts.paraphrase: When launching an assessment, search using the exact template name and verify that the selected record type matches.
When launching from Active Assessments, verify that the template belongs to the same solution.
In the gallery, verify the exact name and the solution where the template was created, then check archived templates if it still does not appear.

knowledge_base.title: Managing Skip or Show Logic Conditions
knowledge_base.section: To configure skip or show logic settings

facts.paraphrase: In vendor templates, Show logic can display questions according to earlier answers. Skip logic can jump to a later question and hide the intervening questions.

incidents.symptom: A vendor cannot submit a launched assessment because the validation message points to a required field they cannot see.
incidents.impact: One test assessment is affected. Wider impact and production deadline are unverified.
timeline: 2026-11-05T18:40:00Z | Support reproduces the symptom on a test copy with one answer path.

evidence.observation: The respondent reports a required-field error for Q12. Q12 is absent from the rendered questionnaire.
On test copy v3, Q12 is absent and submission fails after answering No to Q7. With Yes to Q7, Q12 is visible and the completed test submits.

unknowns: Why the No path still produces a required-field error
Whether other templates, versions or respondents are affected

follow_up.owner: Support with the customer template owner
follow_up.action: Inspect the Q7-to-Q12 conditions on v3, repeat both paths in a test copy, and verify scope before proposing a change.

preventive_follow_up.action: Add submission checks for each conditional answer path before publishing template changes.

claims.text: We confirmed that the draft assessment template was discarded.
We understand this puts tomorrow’s rollout at risk.
The supported path is to create and configure a new template.

proposed_commitment.text: We’ll use your requirements worksheet as the starting point and update you by 2 p.m. Pacific with rebuild progress and remaining risks.

community_signals.title: Onetrust Third Party Risk Management
community_signals.paraphrase: A poster reported that required questions were missing from a launched third-party risk assessment and that submission was blocked.
community_signals.verification: Unverified account. The cause and resolution are unknown.

community_signals.title: RANT- Conditional Formatting on due diligence questionnaires
community_signals.paraphrase: A respondent described how branching questions increased the effort needed to complete a due diligence questionnaire and mentioned online platforms such as OneTrust.
community_signals.verification: Anecdote about respondent effort. It establishes no OneTrust-specific defect.
